My LLM sessions were confusing me, so I built with-my-dashboards
How AI streamlined my digital life
My road to a more productive digital life started when I asked Claude Code (CC) to build a web server for me. It's called with-my-dashboards (WMD), a full-stack web application in a single file that has grown into the control panel for my whole desktop. Its generic core is on GitHub , for you to build your own on.
